newsitem.title: USA: LHS CFO says should meet revs forecast.
newsitem.headline: LHS CFO says should meet revs forecast.

text.p: LHS Group Inc chief financial officer Jerry Braxton said Monday the software company should meet Goldman Sachs estimates of $94 million in revenues this year.
The company had revenues of $57 million last year and $27 million in 1995. Its shares began to trade on the Nasdaq and Frankfurt's Neuer Markt exchanges in May.
Asked if he was comfortable with the June estimate by Goldman Sachs analysts Richard Kramer and Richard Sherlund, Braxton told Reuters, "Yes, sure am."
He was speaking after a press conference for the Neuer Markt.
The Atlanta-based company specializes in client server software and services to wireless and fixed telecoms operators. Its software handles billing and customer care.
Its shares were unchanged Monday at 55.
